title: SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.01278v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. translated_title: SCOPE-AD：面向诊断代理的序贯代价感知序数信念规划与能量模型
translated_abstract: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）的诊断需要在异构的检测成本和患者负担条件下进行序贯式的证据获取。固定模态的预测器无法联合决定应获取哪种检测，也无法判断何时已有证据足以做出诊断。我们提出了SCOPE-AD（Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents，面向诊断代理的序贯代价感知序数信念规划与能量模型），用于对认知正常（CN）、轻度认知障碍（MCI）和AD病例进行代价感知的分类。一个掩码感知的序数模型沿着有序的CN–MCI–AD连续体表示不确定性。回顾性训练记录为基于能量的教师模型提供采样的Bellman目标，该教师的动作分布随后被蒸馏到Qwen策略中。在部署阶段，智能体在可用性和预算约束下选择证据获取动作或诊断动作，且无法访问未获取的检测值。每次获取证据后，证据和序数信念会先被更新，再进行下一个决策（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出SCOPE-AD框架，通过掩码感知的序数信念建模、能量模型教师与Qwen策略蒸馏，使诊断智能体能够在检测成本与患者负担的约束下序贯地决定获取哪些检查以及何时证据足以完成阿尔茨海默病的分期诊断。
en_tdlr: SCOPE-AD introduces a sequential cost-aware planning framework that combines mask-aware ordinal belief modeling with energy-based teacher distillation into a Qwen policy, enabling diagnostic agents to decide which tests to acquire and when the gathered evidence suffices for Alzheimer's disease staging diagnosis.
